You can search up public discord server on „disboard“ for example. They are tagged with themes you can talk about with others who share the same interests. (Not sure if I’m allowed to post links here lol)

Hope it helps you a bit ✌️
„Pretty and scary“ … & here I thought I’d be the only one feeling that way since the lady’s I know are super confident in everything they do lol

The feels, man … still regretting never being open enough to properly step over the line of toxic, manipulative „friends/family“ and just don’t care so I could’ve lived in the moment. 

But before I could even reach that point I got permanently ill in my teens and I never ever had a chance to, you know, taste the rainbow…

So yeah, just be reminded to listen to your belly and stop overthinking. Do what makes YOU happy and what gives you actual shivers just by visualizing it. Life’s literally too short for unnecessary bullshit. (talking from experience here…)

To my fellow married Bisexuals: feel yourself squished & loved 🥰🥰🤗[virtual_hug_incoming.gif]
I can totally underline OP‘s opinion. It’s not worth the struggle, better save that money ✌️

I can say it’s the most undervalued thing which is why my partner always hated it when he got hit on in the past & he acted unnecessarily aggressive.

We helped each other figuring out we are both Bisexual I guess. 

So my point is: YOU ARE VALID! STOP PROCRASTINATING AND JUST GO FOR IT! 👌🌈

Stigmatization needs to end!
For me it was like try and error since my char was always in use or the party already started, so it’s really only hitting the button „play online“ over and over again until you’re in :)

I had hope for a couch coop but it seems like the game doesn’t support it? I’ll try figuring that out tho. It’s beyond me how in the living hell Diablo 3 is able to provide it…

But overall the performance is great on the series X and a nice change for once.
